literal_meaning: অনুরোধে ঢেঁকি চলে গেলা (insistence causes the pestle to go away)
figurative_meaning_bn: অনুরোধ এড়াতে না পেরে অনিচ্ছা সত্ত্বেও কোনো কাজ করা
figurative_meaning_en: Doing something unwillingly because one cannot avoid the request or persuasion
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুর উপরোধে ঢেঁকি গেলা, তাই অনিচ্ছা সত্ত্বেও পার্টিতে গেলাম।
মায়ের অনুরোধে ঢেঁকি গেলা, কাজটা করতে হলো যদিও ইচ্ছে ছিল না।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to my friend's insistence, the pestle went—I ended up going to the party against my will.
Under my mother's persuasion, the pestle slipped; I had to do the task even though I didn't want to.
history: This idiom draws from rural Bengali life where the 'ঢেঁকি' (a wooden pestle used for pounding grains in a mortar) is a common household tool. The metaphor illustrates how persistent urging can force even a heavy, inert object like the pestle to 'move' or 'slip,' symbolizing reluctant compliance in daily chores or decisions.
note: The idiom reflects traditional agrarian practices in Bengal, emphasizing communal persuasion in village settings.
